title: Missing photo — an evidence link whose image could not be loaded
why: The issue links two photographs but one image is unavailable (the app could not read it from storage). The analysis ran on less evidence than the issue records. A finding over partial evidence must not be review_ready without saying so. This case exists to measure whether the pipeline notices a photo the issue links but the packet never received.

photos.caption: extent of mould across head of window

transcripts: Bedroom one, mould to the window reveal and head.

must_not_happen.label: not review-ready when a linked photograph was never analysed

reviewer_notes: KNOWN GAP AT AUTHORING: the packet builder drops a photo without image data silently (server/ai/packet.js), and the app's issueRequest skips photos it cannot load. Unlike a failed transcription, a missing photograph does not mark the packet incomplete. This case is expected to FAIL until that is addressed; it is recorded here so the gap is measured, not forgotten. It is not a model failure.
